title: Letter from Oliver Cowdery, 8 April 1831
source_note: Oliver Cowdery, Letter, Kaw Township, MO, to “My dearly beloved brethren & sisters in the Lord” [Newel K. Whitney and other church members, including JS], [Kirtland Township, OH], 8 Apr. 1831. Featured version copied [between ca. 27 Nov. 1832 and ca. Jan. 1833] in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 10–12; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
